description: This file defines classes and methods for managing employee timesheets and related data in an Odoo (OpenERP) module, including handling analytic lines, employee product info, and default values.

classes.name: hr_employee
classes.description: Extends hr.employee with additional product and journal fields.

classes.name: hr_analytic_timesheet
classes.description: Represents a timesheet line linked to analytic lines, with methods for CRUD operations and default value computations.

methods.name: unlink
methods.description: Deletes associated analytic lines before deleting the timesheet record.

methods.name: on_change_unit_amount
methods.description: Handles changes to unit amount, updating related analytic line data.

methods.name: _getEmployeeProduct
methods.description: Retrieves the product associated with the current user’s employee record.

methods.name: _getEmployeeUnit
methods.description: Retrieves the unit of measure for the employee’s product.

methods.name: _getGeneralAccount
methods.description: Retrieves the expense account for the employee’s product or category.

methods.name: _getAnalyticJournal
methods.description: Retrieves the analytic journal linked to the employee.

methods.name: on_change_account_id
methods.description: Placeholder for handling account ID changes.

methods.name: on_change_date
methods.description: Warns user when changing the date of a timesheet entry.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Creates a new timesheet record, with error handling for missing analytic journal or account.

methods.name: on_change_user_id
methods.description: Updates default fields based on selected user.
